value_basis.combat: max(same-day character/stat API combat power, calculable assumed equipment/hyper/ability/union/Android/cash preset combinations); no fitted stat residuals; missing preset options remain uncomputed

ranking_basis: max(actual same-day API combat power, preset candidates permitted only after exact independent equipped validation and consistent sources); unobserved ammunition is API-only
candidate_discovery: ranking/overall API for names only; includes level 289 as a date-boundary buffer
notes: equipped-exact-v1: only an exact independent equipped baseline with consistent sources permits a preset candidate; unobserved ammunition remains API-only.
All game data uses the requested API calendar date; collection.as_of is the publication cutoff, not a minute-specific game snapshot.
Interim rankings compare published API-backed records as of collection.as_of; pending candidates are not included.
Candidate count includes the level 289 date-boundary buffer and is not the final eligible population.
Counts are a publication snapshot, not a live progress counter.
